appraisal_events.evidence: « Brava ! Brava ! ça c'est très bien... que c'est chic, que c'est crâne... » s'écria la vieille dame prenant la parole au nom des Champs-Élysées silencieux pour remercier Gilberte d'être venue sans se laisser intimider par le temps
appraisal_events.explanation: An old lady, speaking as if on behalf of the whole gathering, publicly praises Gilberte for her spirited, graceful arrival despite the snow, a witnessed compliment before onlookers.

appraisal_events.evidence: ce jour fit pourtant faire un progrès à mon amour... comme un commencement d'intimité... il n'y avait que nous deux de notre bande... elle me fait signe [pour son camp]
appraisal_events.explanation: Being Gilberte's sole companion on this snowbound day and being singled out for her team is explicitly framed by the narrator as a real advance in intimacy and mutual attachment, not mere passing relief.

status_effects.explanation: Gilberte is publicly praised and admired before the assembled Champs-Élysées regulars for her spirited defiance of the weather.
The narrator gains real emotional ground: the shared snowy day is explicitly presented as a genuine advance toward intimacy with Gilberte, not just relief or reunion.
